studies.population: Fourth-year computer science students without previous SPARQL/Semantic Web knowledge
tasks: Two five-task sets of increasing graph-pattern complexity; 40 minutes per interface
measures: Correct queries, triple patterns and graph shapes
studies.results: Mean correctness difference 0.1714 for queries and 0.1928 for shapes significantly favors RDF Explorer; triple-pattern difference 0.06 is not significant.
limitations: Fixed time meant some participants did not reach later tasks; restricted student population.
studies.cohort_note: Cross-report cohort overlap not established; reports are not independent study counts.
